A button greyed out only while its own action runs (`loading` / `running`), the header's inline-edit lock (`disableDuringInlineEdit`) and the host-injected Edit / Delete (`RecordContext.headerSystemActions`, a host-computed boolean) give no reason. RIGHT, and it is why the repo's one existing idiom (`title` on a disabled Button) could not be reused. The span carries `data-disabled-reason=""` as the test hook; a DOM marker, not a prop or type. The new tab stop exists only while the reason applies (control: no wrapper when the predicate does not hold).
